competences.description: Attacks an enemy and stuns the target for 1 turn with a 35% chance.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies and inflicts Continuous Damage for 2 turns. In addition, when used in Beast Form, attacks 2 times and transforms into Druid Form after the attack.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

competences.description: Attacks all enemies to remove all beneficial effects and increase their chance of landing a Glancing Hit for 2 turns. In addition, when used in Druid Form, transforms into Beast Form afterwards and provokes all enemies for 1 turn with a 70% chance.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)

The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.
The target is forced to attack the Monster that is provoked.

competences.description: Inflicts additional damage that's proportionate to your MAX HP when attacking. Counterattacks with a 50% chance when attacked. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: When attacked, the target will counterattack to inflict 75% of the Attack Power as damage.
